paper_title: I Don't Know Explicit Modeling of Uncertainty with an [IDK] Token
caption: : Tradeoff between and for different parameter combinations. We annotate each data point with its corresponding value.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the tradeoff between IDK recall and IDK error rate for different parameter combinations, with the x-axis representing IDK error rate on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.25, and the y-axis representing IDK recall on a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 0.7. Four lines are shown, each representing a different combination of $\mathcal{L}_{Fp-reg}$ and $\lambda$: the blue solid line with 'x' markers represents 'No $\mathcal{L}_{Fp-reg}$, fixed $\lambda$', starting at approximately (0.025, 0.13) and increasing to (0.25, 0.65); the orange solid line with 'o' markers represents 'With $\mathcal{L}_{Fp-reg}$, fixed $\lambda$', starting at around (0.025, 0.13) and rising to (0.17, 0.62); the green dashed line with triangular markers represents 'No $\mathcal{L}_{Fp-reg}$, adaptive $\lambda$', beginning at about (0.03, 0.12) and increasing to (0.2, 0.5); and the red dashed line with triangular markers represents 'With $\mathcal{L}_{Fp-reg}$, adaptive $\lambda$', starting at roughly (0.03, 0.2) and sharply rising to (0.08, 0.5). Each data point on the lines is annotated with its corresponding value.
